scores.notes: Moses (standing on the rocky outcrop at center-left on the left, and walking at the head of the crowd center-right on the right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, olive skin, and a matching slender build.

Simon Peter (standing center-left raising the lame man on the left, and turning toward the courtyard fire in the left foreground on the right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with thick curly dark salt-and-pepper hair, a matching full beard, weathered tan skin, and a prominent nose.

Both images show the same pebbly shoreline of the Sea of Galilee bordered by reeds, low trees, and terraced tan-and-green hills across calm blue-green water, viewed up close by the shore fire on the left and from the fishing boat looking back toward Jesus and the smoking fire on the right.

The left image shows bright sunny daytime at Eyford Station with green leafy trees and sunlit fields around the distant smoke plume, whereas the right image shows the burning house in pitch-black night with leafless trees and a glowing lantern, a day-to-night conflict not asked for by the consecutive passages.

Alice (standing right of the mushroom on the left, and towering on the left side of the courtroom on the right) is the same fair-skinned young girl with long wavy light-brown hair, matching facial features, and slender child build.

Dr. Watson (standing at left in a bowler hat with his medical bag outside the shop on the left, and held by Holmes's arm while holding his hat and bag at center-right on the right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with a square jaw, thick dark-brown moustache, and matching complexion and build.

Both images show the same walled garden croquet-ground with furrowed green grass, playing-card soldiers bent into hoops, lush hedges and trees, and a low reddish-brick garden wall under a bright cloudy sky.

Jesus (standing center-left in the boat rebuking the storm on the left, and gesturing toward Lazarus's tomb at center-left on the right) is the same lean, olive-skinned man with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a full dark beard, and matching facial structure.

Daniel (standing at left addressing the king in the banquet hall on the left, and standing center among the lions on the right) is the same older man with short cropped grey-white hair, a neatly trimmed grey beard, olive skin, and a matching slender build.

Both images depict the same underground bank vault cellar with arched brick vaulting, uneven stone flagstone flooring, and stacks of wooden packing crates and iron-bound boxes illuminated by a small lantern.

Sherlock Holmes (seated at left examining a photograph on the left, and standing by the open door at far right pulling Watson in on the right) is the same lean, clean-shaven man with swept-back dark hair, a high forehead, sharp cheekbones, and an angular nose.

Both images show the same pebbly shoreline of the Sea of Galilee beneath terraced tan-and-green hills dotted with sparse olive trees under a pale sky, viewed up close by the shore fire on the left and from the boat looking back toward Jesus and the smoking fire on the right.

Simon Peter (leaping from the boat at center-left on the left, and turning toward the courtyard fire in the left foreground on the right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with thick curly dark salt-and-pepper hair, a matching full beard, weathered tan skin, and a prominent nose.
